notes: I added the E7 anchors just past the onset (51.5–54 on both sides) so the model captures the steep nonlinear rise between |x|=48 and |x|=52 instead of linearly interpolating from the flat value. The flat region boundary is confirmed at |x|≤48 (E3, E5, E6, E7 all show -84.3663 up to 48 and growth starting at 51.5).
